- Baseline: full-year = tier annual premium per liability step (Special Enhanced 14.00) × 1 step, rounded half-up.
- Factors found on the step premium, multiplied together then applied once:
  - Household liability (HomeGuard Household Liability Credit): in-force HomeGuard with personal liability 500000 ("500,000 USD or more") → 0.80. Records: find_home_policies `status 'in_force'`, `liability_limit 500000.0`.
  - Liability loss experience: medical payments / personal liability claim payments fewer than 60 whole months before the raise — medical_payments payment 2023-12-20 (33 whole months) → exactly one → 1.25; the unit_property payment is not counted.
  - Tenure multiplier: first inception 2016-04-15 → 125 whole months (bound_date 2016-03-30 also 125) → "120 or more" → 0.85.
  - Product 0.80 × 1.25 × 0.85 = 0.85 → 14.00 × 0.85 = 11.90 full-year (`annual_premium_change` 11.90).
- Rest-of-term (Billing the CondoGuard Liability Step Charge): quarterly, 2 of 4 installments posted with term effective date 2026-04-15 → 2 unbilled → share 2/4 → 11.90 × 0.5 = 5.95 (`prorated_premium` 5.95).

- Rest-of-term (Earning of the CondoGuard Rental Charge): no payment returned in 12 months; quarterly with 2 installments unbilled → share 2/4 → 95.68 × 0.5 = 47.84 (`prorated_premium` 47.84).

### Two-way counter-proof
- "Do only what the customer asked" (record the rental endorsement at liability 300000): excluded by "not recorded until the declarations carry the higher …" and its restatement "while the declarations carry the lower … no unit rental endorsement is recorded on the policy". The trial run shows the user tool itself accepts the call at 300000 (receipt `rental_endorsement_added`), so only the visible rule excludes it — the rule is on the visible surface.
- Landlord load 0 (rating at the lower limit) — excluded: the endorsement can only be recorded once the higher limit is on the declarations, and Rule 3 then gives the step premium.
- Landlord load = adjusted 11.90 — excluded: Rule 3 says "the tier's annual premium per liability step".
- Day-fraction shares for either charge — excluded by the quarterly/unbilled rows of the two billing-share documents; the rental returned-payment row (a) is excluded because no returned payment exists.
- Liability share vs rental share: the liability rule uses unbilled/4 for quarterly, as does the rental earning rule; no monthly-EFT difference in play.
- Returning landlord 0.96 — excluded: 2019-06-01→2021-08-01 is 26 whole months.
- Companion 0.95 — excluded: 125 months ≥ 60.
- Insuring the rented unit under LandlordGuard instead: binding guideline 4 sends a rented unit there only "on other tiers"; Special Enhanced allows the endorsement.
- Effective 1 October (tenant move-in) — excluded: both documents fix the effective day as the request day, and the customer wants today.
- Two Coverage A-type actions: master policy single_entity, Coverage A 55000 ≥ single-entity minimum 30000 — no realignment needed.

- The user tool does not enforce the liability precondition; the gate exists only in the visible rule.
